excludeRects.name: plain field text (no bezel; the whole 16 pt line)

textOriginGate.yToleranceReason: plain-v1 (no bezel) measured on all 20 runs (Windows minus Mac, px): first glyph top +1, baseline 0 (the 13 DIP Segoe UI Variable Text (G70) glyph is 1 px shorter than the 13 pt SF one, decision 2); the line is placed the same way
textOriginGate.scanInteriorReason: no bezel: the text starts 1 px inside the frame edge (x 27 of a frame at 25 on Mac), inside the 2 px side margin of bezeled fields, so the scan starts at the frame edge
